newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TENNIS-ROMANIA NAME DAVIS CUP SQUAD TO MEET NETHERLANDS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ROMANIA NAME DAVIS CUP SQUAD TO MEET NETHERLANDS.

text.p: Romania named a four-man team headed by Adrian Voinea to face the Netherlands in their first-round world group Davis Cup match next week in Bucharest.
Captain Florin Searceanu named Andrei Pavel, Razvan Sabau and Ion Moldovan to the squad in addition to Voinea, who is ranked 45th on the ATP listings.

Included as an alternate for the February 7-9 match was Dinu Pescariu. He agreed to be part of the squad after originally refusing in protest at being left out in the team's last match against Belgium.
Romania won that match to qualify for the world group for the first time in 12 years.
